payload.title: Add Start End timeline trimming buttons and S/E shortcuts
acceptance: Start at playhead deletes earlier content across all scene tracks and rebases retained content to zero; End deletes later content.
Expose canonical typed capabilities with validation, revision/idempotency, dry run and undo; UI and keyboard use canonical transactions.
S and E trigger Start and End outside text inputs, resolving existing shortcuts; visible buttons show shortcuts.
Verify crossing clips, source trims, keyframes/captions/bookmarks and undo; deploy and inspect live UI without modifying user projects.
